text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 30

An all-male panel is common enough in municipal government that by itself it proves nothing — it's background, not evidence. Lead with the concrete asymmetry instead: you hold a master's, a licence and twelve years of planning experience; he holds a bachelor's and consultation experience. That gap demands explanation. Note, though, that director roles are often political, and panels legitimately weight stakeholder skill over technical credentials — so the gap isn't automatically pretext.

Your strongest point is the ignored request. Send a written follow-up citing any policy or statutory right to reasons, with a deadline. Mention panel composition once, factually, as context. If the reasons come back thin or shifting, that's when it gains weight.
